rules.anchor: Do not apply ASD-STE100's controlled vocabulary.

rules.why: every factual claim is labelled by how it is known

rules.anchor: Never state an assumption as fact
rules.why: an assumption is stated as an assumption

rules.anchor: if that place isn't here, cut it
rules.why: information lives in the artifact that owns it

rules.anchor: Run `node "<skill base directory>/scripts/prose-scan.mjs" <file>` on each file about to be committed.
rules.why: the tic list lives in one script, so the skill holds no regex copy that can drift

rules.anchor: Exit 1 prints one `file:line: tic "text" is not allowed; fix: <how>` line per hit.
rules.why: a hit gives the line and the fix, so the reader acts without opening the script

rules.anchor: Exit 2 is a usage error: surface the output.
rules.why: a usage error means the scan did not run, so a clean result is not claimed
